n: Hofstra Light and Sound Lesson Plan
t: A grade 7-8 unit where students build a light and sound show that reacts to motion.
steps: Find the Light and Sound Lesson Plan from Hofstra and open the teacher version.
Gather the sensor and LED kit.
Confirm the programming software. The materials do not name it.
Test the sensor with a hand moved inside a box.
Plan eight days of class time.
Share the rubric with students before they design.
Run a show demonstration at the end.
